layercast.message.status: Layer sharing %s: %d layer(s) in use by OBS, channel '%s'
layercast.config.generic.comment.enabled:
Master switch for sharing layers with OBS.
The hotkey toggles it live.
layercast.config.generic.comment.channel:
Name of the shared channel. It must match
the Channel setting of the OBS sources.
When several Minecraft instances run at
once, give each one its own channel.
layercast.config.generic.comment.maxFps:
Upper limit for how often layers are
re-rendered. The effective rate never
exceeds the OBS frame rate.
layercast.config.generic.comment.transpo:
How frames reach OBS.
Auto: zero-copy GPU sharing, with CPU
  shared memory as fallback.
GPU: GPU sharing only.
CPU: always through shared memory
  (for troubleshooting).
layercast.config.generic.comment.slots:
Number of shared surfaces per layer
(ring buffer). 3 is enough in almost
all cases; 4 avoids dropped frames when
the game runs close to the OBS frame rate.
layercast.config.generic.comment.renderW:
Render every layer even when no OBS
source is showing it.
Normally a layer is only rendered while
OBS displays it.
layercast.config.layers.comment.hotbar:
The hotbar with the status bars above it,
the experience bar and the held item name
layercast.config.layers.comment.bossbar: Boss bars at the top of the screen
layercast.config.layers.comment.scoreboa: The scoreboard on the right of the screen
layercast.config.layers.comment.actionba: Action bar messages above the hotbar
layercast.config.layers.name.title: Title & subtitle
layercast.config.layers.prettyName.title: Title & subtitle
layercast.config.layers.comment.title:
Titles and subtitles in the middle of
the screen
layercast.config.layers.comment.subtitle: Sound subtitles
layercast.config.layers.comment.screen:
Inventory, containers, pause menu,
settings and other menus
layercast.config.layers.comment.toasts:
Pop-ups in the top right corner, such as
advancements, recipes, tutorial hints
and system messages
layercast.config.layers.comment.camera:
Full-screen camera overlays: carved
pumpkin, spyglass, freezing, portal and
nausea effects, etc.
layercast.config.layers.comment.nametags: Names above players and named mobs
layercast.config.mod_layer.comment:
The HUD drawn by another mod
(may not always be detected)
layercast.config.hotkeys.comment.showSta:
Shows whether sharing is on and how
many layers OBS currently uses.
layercast.config.hotkeys.comment.dumpLay:
Writes the next frame of every active
layer to .minecraft/layercast-dumps
(diagnostics).
layercast.message.channel_in_use: OBS Layer Cast: channel “%s” is used by another running Minecraft, this game shares on “%s”. Select it as the channel of your OBS sources.
layercast.gui.obs.disabled.hover: Switch on "Enabled" on the General tab.
layercast.gui.obs.connected.hover:
OBS reads channel "%s".
A layer is only rendered while an OBS
source shows it in preview or program.
layercast.gui.obs.plugin_running: OBS plugin running, no source yet
layercast.gui.obs.plugin_running.hover:
The LayerCast plugin runs in OBS, but no
source reads channel "%s".
Add a source "Minecraft Layer (LayerCast)"
or check the Channel of your sources.
layercast.gui.obs.not_detected.hover:
OBS is not running, or the LayerCast
plugin is not installed, outdated or
failed to load (see the OBS log).
layercast.gui.button.download_plugin.hov:
Opens the download page of the
LayerCast OBS plugin.
